name: Brand compliance terms ledger
howToUse: Every OEM / co-op / legal review finding about wording becomes a row here. The build gate 'Brand terms ledger' fails the build when a rule with severity 'fail' matches the article copy, titles, meta, image alt text or slug/path; 'warn' rules print an advisory. The compliance reviewer agent also checks this file. Add new rows with the next id for the brand, the exact source and the date.

rules.scope: all copy, headings, buttons, titles, meta, alt text, URLs/slugs, file names
rules.reason: Mercedes-Benz OEM advertising review fails the word "coupon".
rules.source: Client OEM compliance review relayed by Nasko, 10/09/2026. Supporting: Mercedes-Benz USA Brand Communication Standards Rev.10 (Aug 2015) p.6 lists "Coupon" among terms dealers may not use (public copy: https://retrocdn.net/images/0/08/MercedesBenz_BrandCommunicationStandards_2015-08-20.pdf); current standards are login-only (MBUSA dealer portal).

rules.use: "TSRP" (Total Suggested Retail Price: MSRP + distributor-installed options + delivery, processing and handling), with the region's TSRP disclaimer; never label a TSRP figure "MSRP"
rules.scope: all copy, tables, headings, titles, meta, alt text
rules.reason: Toyota price references use TSRP, not MSRP.
rules.source: Client OEM compliance guidance relayed by Nasko, 10/09/2026. Supporting: Southeast Toyota window sticker "TOTAL SUGGESTED RETAIL PRICE" (https://sync.dealeralchemist.com/ddoa/monroney/5TDYRKEC4TS326778); Toyota dealer sites use TSRP since ~10/2023. Note: toyota.com model pages still say "Starting MSRP" (https://www.toyota.com/camry/). Toyota Dealer Advertising Covenant (TDAC) is login-only.
rules.confidence: HIGH (client rule; Nasko 10/09: always TSRP for every Toyota dealer)
rules.note: Toyota pages never show competitor prices (Nasko 10/09/2026): compare rivals on specs/features only, so "MSRP" never appears on a Toyota page.

rules.use: neutral wording; describe the actual offer
rules.reason: MBUSA standards ban distress wording in dealer advertising.
rules.source: MBUSA Brand Communication Standards Rev.10 (2015) p.6/p.20 (public copy above); current version login-only

rules.use: avoid; articles carry no dealer pricing
rules.reason: MBUSA standards list these among terms dealers may not use.
rules.source: MBUSA Brand Communication Standards Rev.10 (2015) p.6

rules.use: remove, or cite the substantiating source in the copy
rules.reason: MBUSA requires substantiation and a source disclaimer for superlatives.
rules.source: MBUSA Brand Communication Standards Rev.10 (2015) p.20

rules.match: \b(out[- ]the[- ]door (price )?(of |at |for |is )?\$[\d,]+|our price|you'?ll pay|no hidden fees|no dealer fees|no markups?|(at|below|under) (msrp|tsrp|invoice)|dealer cost|invoice price|lowest price|best price|price match)\b
rules.use: remove; articles state no dealer price (MSRP/TSRP only as labeled OEM reference data)
rules.reason: Advertised price must be the total any consumer can pay; price claims need full all-in pricing.
rules.source: FTC "Automobile Industry Pricing Transparency: FAQs" (press release 09/15/2026), https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/industry/automobiles; Va. Code 46.2-1581(7); CA SB 766

rules.use: remove; articles carry no finance terms (a trigger term forces full down-payment/terms/APR disclosure)
rules.reason: 12 CFR 1026.24(d)(1) trigger terms; rate must be stated as APR (1026.24(c)).

rules.match: (due at signing|\$0 down|zero down|no money down|lease for \$|lease from \$|no payment required)
rules.use: remove; articles carry no lease terms
rules.reason: 12 CFR 1013.7(d)(1) trigger terms require full lease disclosures.

rules.use: remove; no offer amounts in articles (link to the specials page instead)
rules.reason: Rebate/savings amounts cannot be deducted from or substitute for an all-in price.
rules.source: FTC "Automobile Industry Pricing Transparency: FAQs" (press release 09/15/2026), https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/industry/automobiles; CA SB 766

rules.use: only in neutral, educational context with an OEM source; never as an offer
rules.reason: Offer-style wording in editorial copy reads as advertising.
rules.source: FTC "Automobile Industry Pricing Transparency: FAQs" (press release 09/15/2026), https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/industry/automobiles

rules.use: only with the OEM program name and its conditions (e.g. "ToyotaCare covers…, see dealer for details")
rules.reason: "Free" only when no purchase is required, or with conditions stated.
rules.source: Va. Code 46.2-1581(11); FTC Guide Concerning Use of the Word "Free" (16 CFR 251)

rules.match: \b(in stock|while supplies last|limited (time|availability|supply)|arriving soon|act now|won'?t last)\b
rules.use: remove; no inventory or urgency claims
rules.reason: Availability must be stated accurately; urgency claims are banned in the article standard.
rules.source: FTC "Automobile Industry Pricing Transparency: FAQs" (press release 09/15/2026), https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/industry/automobiles; Va. Code 46.2-1581(12a)

rules.term: MSRP/TSRP must be labeled as not a dealer price
rules.require: (not (a |an |the )?dealer(ship)?('s)? (selling )?(prices?|offers?)|not (a |an )?(dealer )?offers?|contact (the|our) dealership for (current )?pricing|not the price you pay)
rules.use: add: "MSRP/TSRP is the manufacturer's suggested price as of MM/DD/YYYY, excludes destination, taxes, title, registration, dealer fees and options, and is not a dealer selling price. Contact the dealership for current pricing."
rules.reason: MSRP may appear only as clearly-understood reference data, not the consumer's price.
rules.source: FTC "Automobile Industry Pricing Transparency: FAQs" (press release 09/15/2026), https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/industry/automobiles

rules.use: state the destination charge or "excludes $X destination"
rules.reason: Advertised-price definitions include destination (FL, VA); OEM disclaimers state it.
rules.source: FTC "Automobile Industry Pricing Transparency: FAQs" (press release 09/15/2026), https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/industry/automobiles; Fla. Stat. 501.976(16); Va. Code 46.2-1581(8)

rules.term: any $ figure on New Jersey dealer articles
rules.use: no dollar figures in NJ articles (NJ requires "price(s) include(s) all costs…" with any vehicle price, which would be false next to MSRP)

rules.term: any $ figure on California dealer articles
rules.use: model-level OEM MSRP only in a labeled comparison table (no VIN/stock/inventory link) AND dealer-counsel sign-off before the first CA publish with $ figures; otherwise use relative wording ("about $3K more than")
rules.reason: California CARS Act (SB 766), effective 10/01/2026: total-price rules for ads naming a vehicle; MSRP-with-disclaimer ads no longer sufficient per ComplyAuto.
rules.source: CA SB 766 (Assembly analysis 07/16/2025); ComplyAuto analysis 10/09/2025; CDK 09/22/2026

research: Sources and open questions: SALES_ARTICLES/2026.10.09-COMPLIANCE-TERMS-LEDGER.md (project). OEM ad standards / co-op portals are login-only (MBUSA, Toyota TDAC, Ansira co-op for Ford/Honda, Mazda co-op): ask the client for current PDFs to replace 2015 citations.
